title: Budget and Revenue
text:
This page explores the relationship between film budgets and worldwide revenues. Figure 1 shows each film as one point, with values in millions of US dollars.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (million US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (million US dollars)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Film budgets and worldwide revenues in millions of US dollars.

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
This page explores the relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating. Figure 1 shows how ratings vary across films of different lengths.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Film runtimes in minutes and IMDb ratings.






films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
